name: nt65
description: nt65 assembly: highlighting, and the Norristown language server.

config.description: The named configuration from nt65.json to build, such as "debug". Left out, the project's `default` configuration builds, or its own settings when it names none.

project.description: The project file, or the directory holding it, relative to the workspace folder. Left out, nt65 finds it from the folder the build runs in.

nt65.server.path.description: Path to the Norristown language server executable. Empty uses the server packaged with the extension, or the Debug build of this repository when the extension runs from it.

nt65.cli.path.description: Path to the nt65 command the build tasks run. Empty uses `nt65` on the path, or the Debug build of this repository when the extension runs from it.

nt65.configuration.description: The named configuration from nt65.json the editor analyzes the program as, such as "debug". Empty uses each project's `default` configuration, or its own settings when it names none. A project that lacks the named configuration uses its default too.

nt65.inlayHints.stateChanges.description: Show, at the end of a line after which a width, the emulation flag, the direct page or the data bank differs, what they now are. 65816 only.

nt65.inlayHints.longBranches.description: Show `long` on a branch whose target is out of reach of the two-byte form, which is written as the opposite branch over a `jmp`.

nt65.inlayHints.impliedValues.description: Show the value an enum member takes from the one before it, where a struct or union member lands, and what a constant given as a sum works out to.

nt65.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Show, before each positional argument of a macro or `.func` call, the name of the parameter it is for.

nt65.inlayHints.cycles.description: Show what every instruction costs, and above each block its total. Every line has one, so this is off until it is asked for; `nt65: Toggle Cycle Counts` turns it on for the session without saving it.

nt65.lineLength.description: Suggest laying out a call's arguments, a set or a list of parameters one item to a line, or writing the items of an `.export`, `.import`, `.use` or `.next` as a block, where a line is longer than this many columns. 0 turns the suggestion off.

nt65.diagnostics.onlyWhileOpen.markdownDescription: Globs, relative to the workspace folder and in the form of `files` in nt65.json, naming files whose problems are shown only while they are open, such as `tests/fixtures/**/*`. Every other file of every project is reported whether or not it is open. The files are still analyzed with their projects.

nt65.sources.chipLength.description: The most characters the chips after the caret line may take, and those on the line that opens the routine. Registers come first, then flags, widths and memory, and a `+N` box counts the chips that did not fit, which the hover still lists. 0 means no limit.

nt65.sources.enabled.description: Show, when the caret is on an instruction, where each value it reads was set: the lines are tinted in the value's colour, and the caret line gets a chip per value. On a call, the values are the ones the routine called reads. `nt65: Toggle Input Sources` turns this on and off.
